candidates.change_summary: Replace the target address with a different address so that the external call sends funds to a different contract.
Delete the external call so that msg.value is not forwarded and contract balance before transfer changes.
Change the value passed to the external call to zero so that no value is forwarded regardless of msg.value.
Replace the transfer to owner with a transfer to a different address so that the final recipient of the balance changes.
Delete the require check so that a failed external call does not revert, changing the state of go after completion.
Replace the transfer of entire balance with a fixed small amount so that the owner receives less.
